sources.title: Brazil - Lei no 9.503 Codigo de Transito Brasileiro (Presidencia da Republica)
sources.organization: Brazil - Lei no 9.503 Codigo de Transito Brasileiro (Presidencia da Republica)
sources.facts_supported: Art.96 vehicle classification: CAMINHONETE = cargo vehicle with gross vehicle weight up to 3,500 kg; CAMIONETA = mixed vehicle carrying passengers and cargo in the same compartment; veiculo de carga may carry two passengers besides driver; LOTACAO = max useful load (kg for cargo / number of persons for passengers); CNH categories by seats/GVW; Art.99 weight/dimension limits set by CONTRAN; Art.109 cargo in passenger vehicles only per CONTRAN norms. Amended by Lei 14.440/2022 and 14.599/2023.

sources.title: Peru SUNAT (Aduanas)
sources.facts_supported: Importacion de Vehiculos: DAM via customs agent + invoice + optional insurance + B/L; NEW vehicles need vehicle ID code, Homologation Registry (Reglamento Nacional de Vehiculos Anexo V) or manufacturer/conformity certificate; USED vehicles under regular regime need Ficha Tecnica (with chartered mechanical engineer) plus a Verifying Entity inspection report confirming technical and emission LMP compliance; index covers antiguedad, kilometraje, siniestrabilidad, steering side, emissions.

sources.title: Argentina Government (ANMAT/Secretaria - tramite LCM via TAD/ARCA)
sources.organization: Argentina Government (ANMAT/Secretaria - tramite LCM via TAD/ARCA)
sources.facts_supported: New vehicles need LCM (Licencia para Configuracion de Modelo) and LCA to circulate; for manufacturer/importer via TAD; WP.29 whole-vehicle certification can use CVHE; autos/camionetas with a Brazil CAT can obtain LCM under the Mutual Recognition Agreement (ARM); multistage vehicles need Constancia Tecnica (Decree 196/2025); fees listed as of 01/08/2026.

claim_source_matrix.CLAIM: Brazil (CTB Art.96) classifies CAMINHONETE as a cargo vehicle with GVW up to 3,500 kg and CAMIONETA as a mixed passenger+cargo vehicle in the same compartment; a cargo vehicle may carry only two passengers besides the driver.
claim_source_matrix.SOURCE_ORG: Brazil - Lei no 9.503 Codigo de Transito Brasileiro (Presidencia da Republica)

claim_source_matrix.CLAIM: Brazil defines LOTACAO as maximum useful load (kg for cargo / persons for passengers) and sets GVW/weight limits via CONTRAN (Art.99); carrying cargo in passenger vehicles follows CONTRAN norms (Art.109) - the legal basis for payload/use boundary.
claim_source_matrix.SOURCE_ORG: Brazil - Lei no 9.503 Codigo de Transito Brasileiro (Presidencia da Republica)

claim_source_matrix.CLAIM: Peru controls used-vehicle imports via a technical sheet and verifying-entity inspection (age/km/accident/steering/emissions indexes) - destination admission gate for a used pickup.
Argentina requires LCM (+LCA) for a new model to circulate and recognises Brazil CAT via mutual recognition - model-configuration admission for pickups sold from/through Brazil.
claim_source_matrix.SOURCE_ORG: Argentina Government (ANMAT/Secretaria - tramite LCM via TAD/ARCA)
claim_source_matrix.EXACT_SUPPORT: Argentina LCM page incl ARM with Brazil CAT.

claim_source_matrix.CLAIM: Global NCAP FleetSafe offers fleet purchasing safety guidance (global, not a Latin American admission rule).
MERCOSUR homepage does not itself establish a pickup classification or admission rule.
claim_source_matrix.EXACT_SUPPORT: Homepage only; no exact support for classification.
claim_source_matrix.NOTE: Candidate used it as 'regional authority source' - downgraded: it cannot support the specific commercial/passenger claim.

claim_source_matrix.CLAIM: World Bank LPI is logistics-performance background, not a vehicle classification/admission source.
Never treat a badge-level max towing/payload as the offered build's figure; require qualifying-configuration OEM data + VIN/build label (methodology).
claim_source_matrix.EXACT_SUPPORT: Procedural guidance, not an external factual assertion; requires no external source and must not be presented as a regulation.

claim_source_matrix.CLAIM: UNECE WP.29 is the global type-approval regulatory framework; it does not classify a pickup under Brazilian/LA commercial-vs-passenger law.
